summary: Read the hub, its Context, and all 71 source pages (frontmatter plus every passage that names the hub or a pillar); sampled bodies, not every line, of the long ones (Maker, Meadows and Music, the bridges). Pattern: the 109 inbound links are mostly the pillars: tag re-said as an edge. Where a page's own sentence carries the relation it names a real register (Striatum, Merleau-Ponty, Latent Error, Signal-Rate, Metric Modulation, JSUI, Deposit Ceremony, Palace Philosophies, Palace Voice), so those get labels or a retype. The 14 People pages all sit member-of Source Library, which already deepens the hub, so they are cut; the 10 Cross-Domain bridges keep exemplifies (SCHEMA's own example) with one shared label, Kick Drum with its own; maker pages and project pages with no sentence are cut. Trickster duplicates the hub's own outbound edge. I could not settle: whether the 9 shared 'cross-domain-bridge' labels are worth keeping over a cut (the cross-domain hub's path already reaches the hub); whether Radio Play's sound-leads and Lateral Access's make-and-learn sentence deserve a hub link later; and none of the nine priority newcomers other than CHILD touched this room, so I proposed only the CHILD edge.
